name: merc engineer bomb ring
comment: The Space Merc Engineer's bomb ring: four bombs circling the player he casts it at (footage), staying where they were spawned, lasting ~10 s on a ~9 s cooldown and blowing up on a player (user's memory). Spell 374158 is the engineer's (next to his shot's 374159-374161) but has no client definition, so the rest is made up: an invisible anchor where the player stands (npc/merc-engineer-bomb-anchor) that the bombs (skill/merc-engineer-bombs) circle; his shot's range (11 m). The bombs' look is still to be found (item/grenade renders a potion).
